items.name: Voracious Heart of Ula'tek
items.guideNote: Why? With static Critical Strike, on-demand Agility every 90 seconds, bonus Physical damage that interacts with your tier set and the Shado-Pan talents, and an increased item level on Mythic, this trinket has absolutely everything you would want as a Brewmaster. Seek it out, even on Heroic.

items.name: Zul'jin's Guillotine Technique
items.guideNote: , this trinket's baseline 3ppm effect is strong enough on its own to be a valuable pickup. The extra item level on Mythic certainly helps, too, as does its Physical damage being enhanced by both your tier set and the Shado-Pan Hero Talents.

items.name: Font of Venomous Rage
items.guideNote: Why? Its 4-minute cooldown is hefty, and you are unable to dodge attacks during its channel, but the damage output of this trinket is particularly exceptional in single-target. It is your strongest option for burst damage, especially at its Mythic item level of 344.

items.name: Tumor of the Swarm
items.guideNote: Why? Although this is a tank trinket, its damage is surprisingly potent while also providing a helpful stream of healing at a rate of 3ppm. In spite of splitting its damage among enemies, the total amount dealt per proc also increases, making it an incredibly passive, "hybrid" option for AoE.

items.name: Lustrous Golden Plumage
items.guideNote: , but only for Master of Harmony Brewmasters.

items.name: Tiny Electromental in a Jar
items.guideNote: Why? Still just as strong as it was in Battle for Azeroth, this trinket builds roughly 20 charges per minute and unleashes Nature damage with every 12 accumulated. By also including a chaining effect, it remains potent across a variety of target counts while being an option that is easy enough to obtain from Mythic+.

items.name: Gebbo's Bottomless Bag
items.guideNote: 12-second ramping Critical Strike and self-bleed;

items.name: Vashnik's Sanguine Rancor
items.guideNote: Why? By offering benefits to its damage (triggering roughly once per minute) against only a single target and also against multiple, this trinket is a convenient universal and passive option for damage.

items.name: Freightrunner's Flask

items.name: Lightspire Core
items.guideNote: Why? While this trinket does provide a useful amount of Mastery, remember that you must be able to stand in its light beam to gain its full benefit; this may not always be feasible in the middle of combat.

items.name: Keeper's Seething Core
